newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium urges nationals to leave Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Belgium urges nationals to leave Zaire.

text.p: Belgium issued a new call on Sunday for its nationals living in eastern Zaire to leave the country, as fighting between ethnic Tutsis and Zairean troops worsened.
A foreign ministry spokesman said the Belgian embassy in Kinshasa had individually contacted the 230 Belgians remaining in the two war-torn provinces of north and south Kivu.
The spokesman said Brussels was also in contact with its European partners, notably France, and international organisations on the situation in the country.
He said some Belgians, notably missionaries who had lived in Zaire for many years, were reluctant to leave.
